property_summary: Only the current owner may change ownership: for any caller, a call to setOwner either leaves owner unchanged (if the caller is not the owner) or succeeds setting it (if the caller is the owner); the mutant lets any caller change owner, so a non-owner caller changes c.owner().
change_summary: Replace the access check with `require(true);` so the modifier never reverts and anyone can call setOwner and set the owner to themselves.
